description: Computes the exact WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between a foreground and background color (relative-luminance formula) and reports AA/AAA pass-fail for normal text (4.5 / 7), large text (3 / 4.5), and UI components (3).

background.description: Background color. Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

foreground.description: Foreground (text) color. Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

name: check_contrast
title: Check Color Contrast
